sources.researchNote: The uploader dates the recording to Berlin in 1930 and describes the copy as a French Parlophone issue; neither statement is printed on the filmed label.

sources.fullCitation: “Otto Dobrindt.” Wikipedia (German). Records that he joined Carl Lindström AG in 1924 as a recording manager and became its chief recording manager, and that from 1925 he issued his own productions under pseudonyms including Saxophon-Orchester Dobbri, Odeon Tanz-Orchester, Wiener Bohème-Orchester, Dobbri, Robert Renard, Eddie Saxon, Frank Sandlers, Eric Harden and Götz Höhne; his orchestra accompanied Ufa stars on record, among them Hans Albers.
